card.name: Missed-dose phrase "as soon as"
card.fires_on: The word "as" in "as soon as" (remembered or possible) in missed-dose instructions. Also weakly on linking words like "and" where something goes unnoticed.

modes.label: as soon as
modes.description: The second "as" in "as soon as possible/they remember" after a missed dose.
modes.example: If a subcutaneous maintenance dose of VEOPOZ is missed, administer as soon<< as>> possible within 3 days after the missed

modes.label: Link before unnoticed
modes.description: "and" joining a symptom-free state to going unnoticed.
modes.example: Expulsion may be associated with symptoms of bleeding or pain, or it may be asymptomatic<< and>> go unnoticed.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about noticing or finding out, like "discovered" and "remembered"-type continuations.
card.plain: It lights up on the "as" in "take it as soon as you remember" in missed-dose directions.
